source:
@@U00555@@
But mustn't a word mean? Mustn’t there be a concept behind it?

@@U00557@@
Of course, of course! But don’t let that bother you overmuch. When the well of concepts runs dry, a word in the nick of time will bring on a deluge. Words will help you get up an excellent argument, devise a system, even. They're beautiful things, words are, matters of faith, you know, and they're not to be robbed of even an iota.

@@U00559@@
I’m sorry to plague you with all these questions, but there’s one thing more. Tell me something about Medicine. Something pertinent. I’m certain you can. Three years is such a short time and, Lord! it’s so vast a field. Just a hint from you could be a great help.

@@U00561@@
(Aside.)

@@U00562@@
I've had it with this academic pose; it’s time again for the devil to interpose.

@@U00563@@
(Aloud.)

@@U00564@@
Medicine, my boy, is an art easily grasped. You study the world, the great as well as the small, and end up letting it take its own sweet way, just as God intended in the first place. And don’t waste time dabbling in sciences; it wont help. Each of us learns what he can. Just be certain you don’t fritter away opportunity. Make the most of it. Seize it!
translation:
@@U00555@@
但一个词不应该意味着什么吗？背后不应该有一个概念吗？

@@U00557@@
当然，当然！但不要让这太困扰你。 When the well of concepts runs dry, a word in the nick of time will bring on a deluge. Words will help you get up an excellent argument, devise a system, even. They're beautiful things, words are, matters of faith, you know, and they're not to be robbed of even an iota.

@@U00559@@
I’m sorry to plague you with all these questions, but there’s one thing more.告诉我一些关于医学的事情。一些相关的东西。我确信你可以。三年是多么短的时间，主啊！这是一个如此广阔的领域。只需您的一个提示即可提供很大的帮助。

@@U00561@@
（旁边。）

@@U00562@@
我已经受够了这种学术姿态了；又到了魔鬼介入的时候了。

@@U00563@@
（大声）

@@U00564@@
我的孩子，医学是一门容易掌握的艺术。 You study the world, the great as well as the small, and end up letting it take its own sweet way, just as God intended in the first place.不要浪费时间涉足科学；这没有帮助。我们每个人都尽其所能地学习。只是要确保你不会浪费机会。充分利用它。抓住它！
